title: What It Really Costs to Own a Ferrari F40
description:
A Ferrari F forty cost about four hundred thousand dollars when it was new. Today the sources we read show sale prices from about three and a half million dollars to eleven million. But the purchase price is only the beginning. One recent preparation bill for a low-mileage F forty, itemised line by line, ran to tens of thousands of dollars before the car even went on sale. This is what it really costs to own a Ferrari F forty. We will go through the purchase price, the recent auction results, the maintenance schedule, and the itemised bills we could find. Every figure comes from a published source, listed in the description. Where sources disagree, we will tell you. Where we do the maths ourselves, we will say so. And where a source gives no figure, we will not invent one.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
